title: Extremely wobbly/unsturdy
text: Extremely wobbly/unsturdy. I love the size of this and was easy to assemble, but it’s super wobbly and  in sturdy when loaded. The side poles are constantly having to be tightened and the top tray leans either left or right depending on what side the weight is on it. I wouldn’t order this again. And I’m looking to replace it with something sturdier.
